data.name: Maytham
data.gender_notes: Maytham is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Maytham is a name that symbolizes kindness, compassion, and gentleness. It is derived from the Arabic word mayt, which means 'to have pity or mercy'. The name Maytham carries the meaning “Compassionate and gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maytham usually hope their child will grow to embody compassionate and gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who shows mercy and compassion to others, as described in the Quran.
data.etymology: Maytham belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Compassionate and gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maytham total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Maytham carries a rich cultural significance in the Islamic tradition. In Islamic history, there are several figures with this name, most notably Maytham Al-Tammar, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who is renowned for his piety and kindness towards others. Maytham's name is often Associated with virtues of compassion, mercy, and generosity.
data.spiritual_significance: Moreover, the spiritual significance of the name Maytham is deeply rooted in Islamic teachings. The Quran emphasizes the importance of being kind and compassionate to others and encourages Muslims to show mercy and forgiveness. The name Maytham reminds us of the universal value of compassion and mercy, and it serves as a constant reminder to extend kindness towards all beings.
